info.title: Queue OpenAPI for nvidia/cosmos-3-super/text-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the nvidia/cosmos-3-super/text-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate an image from a text prompt using NVIDIA Cosmos3-Super via vLLM-Omni.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Content to steer the generation away from (colors, objects, artifacts).

agentic_early_stop.title: Agentic Early Stop
agentic_early_stop.description: Stop early when a candidate image is already a strong match for the prompt.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. More steps yield higher quality but take longer.

agentic_samples_per_iteration.title: Agentic Samples Per Iteration
agentic_samples_per_iteration.description: Candidate images to generate and judge per agentic iteration. The best candidate advances to the next rewrite stage.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same seed and prompt given to the same model version will produce the same image every time.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand the prompt with OpenRouter before image generation. When enabled, the prompt is rewritten into the dense structured-JSON format Cosmos3 was trained on; generation falls back to the raw prompt if expansion fails.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Enable content moderation for the input prompt and generated images. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

agentic_max_iterations.title: Agentic Max Iterations
agentic_max_iterations.description: Maximum number of refinement rounds when agentic generation is enabled.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Higher values increase prompt adherence at the cost of diversity.

num_images.title: Num Images
num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

enable_agentic_generation.title: Enable Agentic Generation
enable_agentic_generation.description: Automatically generate and compare multiple candidate images, then refine the prompt between rounds to better match the original request. This can improve prompt adherence but increases latency and billable image generations.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Each edge is clamped to 512-1280px (multiples of 16).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.
examples: A photorealistic close-up of two damp hands shaping a spinning cylinder of wet gray clay on a pottery wheel, fingers pinching the walls upward into a narrow-necked vase, water glistening on the clay, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the image is returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts
has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether each generated image was flagged by the safety checker.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
